text:
Leah Park: Heads-up — I'm drafting the internal release note for tiny-rollout v2026.03.2. Planning a canary at 16:45 PT, broad rollout at 17:15 PT. Draft in progress: https://redwood.internal/rn/drafts/2026-03-2
Samir Gupta: Thanks Leah. Ops needs the exact model pin and commit so we can wire routing and fallback. Also propose explicit rollback thresholds.
Leah Park: Pin proposal: `model_bundle: rbw-slim-0315`, commit `c3f9a1d`. Runtime config `snap-256`. Adding that to the draft now.
Ruth Kim (Docs): I can turn that into the internal blast. Keep the message short — 2 bullets max + canary time. Who's the oncall?
Tom Alvarez (Oncall): I'll be oncall for this window (17:00-19:00 PT). Canary escalation: I'll own the decision to roll back if thresholds hit.
Samir Gupta: Suggest rollback triggers:
```
rollback_triggers:
  - p50_latency_ms: 480
  - error_rate_increase_pct: 1.0
  - mem_ooms: >0
```
Also ops wants the fallback model: `rbw-slim-0308` and runbook link RBW-ROLLBACK-2026.
Leah Park: Good catches. I'll include fallback info and runbook link. Also adding a note to run the mixed-length prompt suite during canary.
QA-Bot: Pre-canary smoke report: staging passed 95/96 checks; one long-prompt memory jitter noted (investigating).
Samir Gupta: Because of that jitter, canary should include a 30% long-prompt sample. If jitter repeats, immediate rollback.
Ruth Kim (Docs): Please send me the final blurb and the pin metadata (bundle + commit + runtime). I'll post preview and schedule internal blast.
Leah Park: Final blurb (for Ruth):
"Internal: Deploying tiny-rollout v2026.03.2. Canary at 16:45 PT, broad rollout at 17:15 PT. Model bundle pinned to rbw-slim-0315 (commit c3f9a1d). Runtime: snap-256. Fallback: rbw-slim-0308. Rollback if p50 > 480ms, error rate +1.0% or any memory OOMs. Oncall: Tom Alvarez. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/RBW-ROLLBACK-2026.
Please review — aiming to publish the internal note 30m before canary."
Samir Gupta: LGTM. Add a short ops checklist in the runbook: preflight queries, cache warm, verify autoscaler upscales to target.
Tom Alvarez: I'll run the checklist 20m before canary and post status here.
Ruth Kim (Docs): Preview posted: https://redwood.internal/rn/previews/2026-03-2 — commenting inline with a one-line oncall callout.
Leah Park: Thanks. @DeployBot, schedule staging->prod canary for 2026-03-26T16:45:00-07:00 and set a 15m reminder.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary scheduled: staging -> prod-canary at 2026-03-26T16:45:00-07:00 (requested by Leah Park). Reminder set for 15 minutes prior.
QA-Bot: Canary smoke hooks set: short-set (70%), long-set (30%), KV cache warmup script queued.
Tom Alvarez: Preflight done: all green except one long-seq memory line — monitoring closely. Standing by at 16:30 PT.
Leah Park: Will post final release note here once the internal blast goes out. Thanks everyone.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary completed: PASS. Metrics snapshot: p50=290ms, error_rate_delta=0.2%, no OOMs. No rollback triggered.
